scenes: Is there one fix for heat?

No. There are a hundred and thirty-one in the library. | Fifty-two cool places without machines, | thirty-seven are active or system cooling, and forty-two are the plans, rules and money that make protection last.
They work best together. | A cool roof, a warning and paid rest protect more than any one alone.
Each with its evidence, cost and limits.
